algorithm: Generate all integers from 1 to n that divide n without remainder.
Sort the list in ascending order.
Return the list as the result.
constraints: Divisors are returned in ascending order
Generator flag is set to False
Proper flag is set to False
edge_cases: n = 5000: return all divisors of 5000 in ascending order
output: An ascending list of all positive divisors of n
purpose: Return all divisors of n sorted from 1 to n.
